Among other things he was involved in the scenery for Richard Wagner 's opera Lohengrin . He was also enlisted as a stage designer for the 1862 Fairytale Maskenfest , spending months painting a 800-meter-long, 50-meter-high panoramic backdrop with a castle overlooking the Rhine . [ 2 ] His work piqued the interest of Ludwig II, who commissioned him to create concepts for his architectural projects inspired by Wagner. Jank's historistic drafts were the basis for Neuschwanstein Castle , which was built starting in 1869 by Eduard Riedel and later Georg von Dollmann . Jank was also involved in the interior of Linderhof Palace . His concepts for Falkenstein Castle could not be realized, as the project was abandoned after the king's death in 1886.
